hypothesis: Corrections lane: GeoDAWN catalogue traces sit more than about two pixels (200 m) from the evidence-defined trace along a consistent direction.
mechanism: A consistent displacement would show as a peak at a constant (dy, dx) in nearest-trace displacements, or as 5 km block means above 2 px with a shared direction.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Rasterisation and generalisation error of 1:50,000 to 1:1,000,000 geologic-map traces (USGS SGMC) and of catalogue traces, which displaces lines by up to a few pixels with no fault involved. Also lithologic contacts and drainage that a map can mistake for faults.
